scope: Bounded purposive audit of documents actually inspected for these two mini-reviews; candidates excluded here are not declared scientifically irrelevant in general.

targetedMachineDoseScan.method: Whitespace-normalized MABEL/starting-dose with NOAEL/HNSTD/STD10; false label-dose and TOC matches adjudicated. Not an exhaustive dose-information detector.
